rag_summary_count_consistency.details: The summary reports four identified occurrences, matching the four identified occurrence objects; all four have identified status and valid confidence values, and candidate_biases is an empty array with no supported-biases flag set to false.

evaluation_limitations: The frozen segment map contains only four eligible reasoning segments, all positive; negative-segment false-alarm and correct-rejection rates therefore have zero denominators.
Corpus-support fidelity cannot be scored because retrieved chunks, source passages, and retrieval logs were not supplied.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I already had a rough read on who'd started it ... chasing down another bystander or two wasn't going to change that picture much, so I didn't send anyone looking.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The principal closes the information search on the first incomplete evidence set under time pressure.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I didn't weight [the stepping-in moment] that heavily ... the pattern ... fit something I'd already seen from him ... the picture I had felt coherent enough to act on.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Conflicting new evidence is explained away and selectively integrated into a tidy narrative consistent with prior referrals.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I felt I understood the full sequence ... I felt confident I had enough of the real story to speak to it publicly. I hadn't gotten to [the counselor or third witness].
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The principal expresses complete causal confidence before a public commitment despite two material sources remaining unconsulted.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The kids came back in largely because we'd handled the day the way we did ... I noted [the fire drill] in passing ... the AP and resource officer ... were both out there doing good work.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: A favorable, team- and chance-influenced outcome is attributed primarily to the principal's own decisions while other causes are downplayed.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_001 quotes and paraphrases the initial evidence-gathering decision and maps to the dp1 anchor.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: The finding is in the correct segment and captures the premature closure mechanism, but its anchoring label is a near-neighbor rather than the hidden Bounded Rationality label.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_002 quotes the decision to downweight the stepping-in evidence and finalize suspension, matching the dp2 anchor.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: The confirmation-bias label is a near-neighbor, while the finding fully captures selective integration of conflicting evidence into the prior-referral narrative.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_003 quotes the principal's confidence in the full sequence despite not consulting the counselor or third witness, matching the dp3 anchor.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: The overconfidence label is a near-neighbor, while the mechanism is a full match for expressed complete understanding despite unconsulted material sources.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_004 quotes the superintendent summary and the principal's discounting of the fire drill and staff contributions, matching the dp4 anchor.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Self-serving bias is an established alias/equivalent for the hidden Self-Enhancement or Self-serving Bias label, and the attribution mechanism is fully supported.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Premature closure of information search under time pressure; treats first available, incomplete evidence set as sufficient to act.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Anchoring bias is a related evidence-weighting construct, but the hidden target is Bounded Rationality and the benchmark does not treat the labels as exact or approved equivalents.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding identifies the initial rough read, incomplete evidence, time pressure, and the decision not to seek additional potentially disconfirming witnesses, fully matching the hidden premature-search-closure mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: Evidence is faithful: the quoted interview material supports the stated initial-read and witness-search decision without fabrication.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Finalization of in-school suspension after the second video and provocation report
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Integrates conflicting new evidence into a single narrative consistent with the prior-referral student's fault, explaining away the misfit.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Confirmation bias is a near-neighbor label for the selective weighting of evidence, but the hidden target specifically requires coherence-preserving integration/rationalisation and is not treated as the same strict label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully captures downweighting the stepping-in evidence, overweighting the pattern-consistent provocation, and preserving the prior-referral student's culpability narrative.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: Evidence is faithful: the quoted stepping-in, pattern, and suspension statements directly support the adjudicated mechanism.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Issuance of the same-day public statement
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Expresses confident, complete comprehension of the incident's causes before a public statement, despite unreviewed third witness statement and uncontacted counselor.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Overconfidence bias is a related confidence-calibration construct, but the hidden target is Illusion of understanding and the benchmark keeps this distinction in the strict scorecard.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding states that the principal treated a known subset as the full sequence and maintained confidence despite explicitly unconsulted counselor and witness sources, fully matching the hidden mechanism.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: Evidence is faithful: the two quoted passages accurately establish both the confidence claim and the known information gaps.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Same-day summary to the superintendent explaining the peaceful walkout
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Attributes the peaceful walkout resolution primarily to own leadership decisions, downplaying colleagues' de-escalation efforts and an unrelated fortuitous fire drill.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Self-serving bias is the established equivalent/alias used in the RAG output for the hidden Self-Enhancement or Self-serving Bias target.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully captures internal credit for the favorable outcome, downplaying the fire drill and staff contributions, plus the success-versus-failure attribution contrast.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: Evidence is faithful: all quoted passages are present in the interview and support the causal-attribution assessment.

high_only.detection_interpretation: Only the high-confidence confirmation-bias finding qualifies; it localizes to one of four positive segments. No negative segments are available for false-alarm estimation.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: All four identified occurrences qualify and correctly localize to the four positive segments; false-alarm estimation is unavailable because every mapped segment is positive.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: All four identified occurrences qualify and correctly localize to the four positive segments; allowing low confidence adds no findings in this run.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: The candidate tier adds no findings, so results are identical to all identified confidence levels.

Full overlap with explaining away conflicting evidence to preserve the prior-referral student's culpability narrative.
Full overlap with confidence in complete causal understanding despite unconsulted material sources.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Segment hit rate rises from 0.25 to 1.0; strict instance F1 rises from 0.0 to 0.25; mechanism-first instance F1 rises from 0.4 to 1.0.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: No change: all four occurrences are already moderate or high, with no low-confidence findings.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, all four positive reasoning segments are detected with no observed false alarms; false-alarm rate is undefined because no negative segments were mapped.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Strict identification finds 1 of 4 hidden instances, with precision 0.25, recall 0.25, and F1 0.25 at high_and_moderate; three correctly localized findings use near-neighbor labels.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first identification finds all 4 hidden instances at high_and_moderate and later thresholds with precision, recall, and F1 all equal to 1.0.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: No candidates were supplied, so the candidate tier neither improves nor harms this run.
main_failure_modes: Three findings use related but non-equivalent labels relative to the hidden ontology, reducing strict label-plus-mechanism performance.
Only one occurrence is high confidence; the other three are moderate, producing a substantial high-only recall drop.
The run provides no negative segments, so false-alarm behavior cannot be estimated.
main_strengths: All four findings localize to the correct decision-point segments.
All four findings capture the hidden mechanisms with full overlap.
Quotes are valid and evidence-faithful, and no unsupported findings or candidates are present.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run demonstrates strong mechanism detection and segment localization but weak strict ontology agreement: the RAG system recognized the intended reasoning patterns while naming three of them with adjacent established constructs rather than the benchmark's hidden labels.
